components.arn:aws:imagebuilder:us-east-1:401233741:
name: studio-gpu-nvidia-res-stage
description: RES 2026.06 NVIDIA GRID with Nouveau reboot and pinned verified driver
schemaVersion: 1.0
phases:
- name: build
  steps:
  - name: PrepareResAndDisableNouveau
    action: ExecuteBash
    onFailure: Abort
    inputs:
      commands:
      - 'set -euxo pipefail

        export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive NEEDRESTART_MODE=a NEEDRESTART_SUSPEND=1

        test "$(uname -m)" = x86_64

        lspci | grep -qi NVIDIA

        apt-get update -o Acquire::Retries=3

        apt-get install -y mesa-utils gcc make binutils pciutils "linux-headers-$(uname -r)"

        dpkg --audit

        mkdir -p /root/bootstrap/latest /root/bootstrap/logs

        aws s3 cp s3://studio-workstation-releases-401233741942-us-east-1/releases/v0.1.3/res-2026.06/installation-scripts.tar.gz
        /tmp/res-installation-scripts.tar.gz --region us-east-1

        echo ''813259748335482b1877192a61a008b32e613038ee831305d9e4767c51c23ab7  /tmp/res-installation-scripts.tar.gz'' |
        sha256sum -c -

        tar -xzf /tmp/res-installation-scripts.tar.gz -C /root/bootstrap/latest

        test -f /root/bootstrap/latest/scripts/common/linux/debian/grub_configuration.sh

        test -f /root/bootstrap/latest/scripts/dcv/linux/gpu_drivers.sh

        RES_SCRIPTS=/root/bootstrap/latest/scripts/dcv

        /bin/bash /root/bootstrap/latest/scripts/common/linux/yq.sh -s "$RES_SCRIPTS"

        /bin/bash /root/bootstrap/latest/scripts/common/linux/jq.sh -o ubuntu2404 -s "$RES_SCRIPTS"

        command -v yq

        command -v jq

        source /root/bootstrap/latest/scripts/common/linux/config_common.sh

        test "$(get_string package_config.gpu_driver.nvidia.s3_bucket_path)" = "s3://ec2-linux-nvidia-drivers/latest/"

        /bin/bash /root/bootstrap/latest/scripts/common/linux/disable_nouveau_drivers.sh -o ubuntu2404 -g NVIDIA -s "$RES_SCRIPTS"

        test "$(cat /root/bootstrap/reboot_required.txt)" = yes

        update-initramfs -u -k "$(uname -r)"

        '
  - name: RebootAfterNouveau
    action: Reboot
    onFailure: Abort
    inputs:
      delaySeconds: 15
  - name: InstallResNvidiaGrid
    action: ExecuteBash
    onFailure: Abort
    inputs:
      commands:
      - "set -euxo pipefail\nexport DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive NEEDRESTART_MODE=a NEEDRESTART_SUSPEND=1\nif lsmod | awk\
        \ '$1 == \"nouveau\" {found=1} END {exit !found}'; then\n  echo 'ERROR: nouveau remains loaded after reboot' >&2\n\
        \  exit 42\nfi\ncommand -v aws\ncommand -v python3\ncommand -v yq\ncommand -v jq\ntest -f /root/bootstrap/latest/scripts/dcv/linux/gpu_drivers.sh\n\
        python3 - <<'PATCH'\nfrom pathlib import Path\np = Path(\"/root/bootstrap/latest/scripts/dcv/linux/gpu_drivers.sh\"\
        )\ns = p.read_text()\na = s.index(\"function install_nvidia_grid_drivers () {\")\nb = s.index(\"function install_nvidia_public_drivers()\"\
        , a)\nf = s[a:b]\nold = '$AWS --region ${DRIVER_BUCKET_REGION} s3 cp --quiet --recursive $NVIDIA_S3_BUCKET_PATH .'\n\
        new = \"\"\"$AWS --region us-east-1 s3api get-object --bucket studio-workstation-releases-401233741942-us-east-1 --key\
        \ dependencies/nvidia-grid/595.91.07/NVIDIA-Linux-x86_64-595.91.07-grid-aws.run --version-id b94g7u7FkVYD9m63G6RE3xHNLZSXrz3r\
        \ NVIDIA-Linux-x86_64-595.91.07-grid-aws.run\n  echo 'cae8d82b8407c6371805485b148aa667550abf1775ea7999be69da81cf593156\
        \  NVIDIA-Linux-x86_64-595.91.07-grid-aws.run' | sha256sum -c -\"\"\"\nassert f.count(old) == 1\nf = f.replace(old,\
        \ new)\nold = 'local x_server_pid=$(cat /tmp/.X0-lock)'\nnew = chr(10).join([\n    'local x_server_pid=\"\"',\n  \
        \  '  if [[ -f /tmp/.X0-lock ]]; then',\n    '    x_server_pid=$(cat /tmp/.X0-lock)',\n    '  fi',\n])\nassert f.count(old)\
        \ == 1\nf = f.replace(old, new)\nold = '/bin/sh NVIDIA-Linux-x86_64*.run --no-precompiled-interface --run-nvidia-xconfig\
        \ --accept-license --silent'\nnew = '/bin/sh NVIDIA-Linux-x86_64-595.91.07-grid-aws.run --no-precompiled-interface\
        \ --run-nvidia-xconfig --accept-license --silent || return $?'\nassert f.count(old) == 1\nf = f.replace(old, new)\n\
        old = '$NVIDIAXCONFIG --preserve-busid --enable-all-gpus'\nnew = '$NVIDIAXCONFIG --preserve-busid --enable-all-gpus\
        \ || return $?'\nassert f.count(old) == 1\nf = f.replace(old, new)\np.write_text(s[:a] + f + s[b:])\nPATCH\n/bin/bash\
        \ /root/bootstrap/latest/scripts/dcv/linux/gpu_drivers.sh -o ubuntu2404 -g NVIDIA -s /root/bootstrap/latest/scripts/dcv\n\
        command -v nvidia-smi\ncommand -v nvidia-xconfig\n"
  - name: RebootAfterNvidia
    action: Reboot
    onFailure: Abort
    inputs:
      delaySeconds: 15
  - name: ConfirmNvidia
    action: ExecuteBash
    onFailure: Abort
    inputs:
      commands:
      - 'set -euxo pipefail

        nvidia-smi -L | grep -E ''Tesla T4|NVIDIA T4|T4''

        test -e /dev/nvidia0

        modinfo nvidia

        test -f /etc/X11/xorg.conf

        grep -qi nvidia /etc/X11/xorg.conf

        '

name: studio-gpu-dcv-res-stage
description: CPU DCV install plus metadata-selected nice-dcv-gl (reject ambiguous matches)
schemaVersion: 1.0
phases:
- name: build
  steps:
  - name: InstallDCV
    action: ExecuteBash
    onFailure: Abort
    inputs:
      commands:
      - "set -euxo pipefail
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive NEEDRESTART_MODE=a
tmpdir=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "\
        $tmpdir"' EXIT
cd "$tmpdir"
base=https://d1uj6qtbmh3dt5.cloudfront.net
curl -fLsS "$base/nice-dcv-ubuntu2404-x86_64.tgz"\
        \ -o dcv.tgz
curl -fLsS "$base/nice-dcv-ubuntu2404-x86_64.tgz.sha256sum" -o checksum
expected=$(awk '{print $1}'\
        \ checksum)
[[ "$expected" =~ ^[a-fA-F0-9]{64}$ ]]
printf "%s  %s\\n" "$expected" dcv.tgz | sha256sum -c\
        \ -
mkdir packages
tar -xzf dcv.tgz -C packages --strip-components=1
shopt -s nullglob
server=(packages/nice-dcv-server_*_amd64.ubuntu2404.deb)
\
        viewer=(packages/nice-dcv-web-viewer_*_amd64.ubuntu2404.deb)
xdcv=(packages/nice-xdcv_*_amd64.ubuntu2404.deb)
 \
        \             # Inspect package metadata instead of trusting an ambiguous gl* filename glob.
# The DCV distribution\
        \ may also contain nice-dcv-gltest.
gl_candidates=(packages/nice-dcv-gl*_amd64.ubuntu2404.deb)
printf 'DCV GL candidates:\
        \ %s\n' "${gl_candidates[@]}"
gl=()
for candidate in "${gl_candidates[@]}"; do
  package_name=$(dpkg-deb -f\
        \ "$candidate" Package)
  printf 'DCV package %s: %s\n' "$candidate" "$package_name"
  if [[ "$package_name"\
        \ == "nice-dcv-gl" ]]; then
    gl+=("$candidate")
  fi
done
if [[ "${#gl[@]}" -ne 1 ]]; then
  printf\
        \ 'ERROR: expected exactly one nice-dcv-gl binary package, found %s\n' "${#gl[@]}" >&2
  exit 43
fi
test "\
        ${#server[@]}" -eq 1
test "${#viewer[@]}" -eq 1
test "${#xdcv[@]}" -eq 1
              # Selected by Debian\
        \ package metadata above.
apt-get install -y "./${server[0]}" "./${viewer[0]}" "./${xdcv[0]}" "./${gl[0]}"\
        
usermod -aG video dcv
install -d /etc/X11/xorg.conf.d /etc/dcv
printf 'Section "Extensions"\\n Option "DPMS"\
        \ "Disable"\\nEndSection\\n' > /etc/X11/xorg.conf.d/99-disable-dpms.conf
cat >> /etc/dcv/dcv.conf <<'DCV'
\
        [security]
authentication="system"
[session-management]
create-session=true
[session-management/automatic-console-session]
\
        owner="workstation"
DCV
systemctl enable dcvserver
"
  - name: RebootAfterDCV
    action: Reboot
    onFailure: Abort
    inputs:
      delaySeconds: 15

name: studio-gpu-dcv-smoke-test-res
description: Original DCV smoke test plus T4 hardware verification
schemaVersion: 1.0
phases:
- name: test
  steps:
  - name: CheckDesktop
    action: ExecuteBash
    onFailure: Abort
    inputs:
      commands:
      - "set -euxo pipefail
systemctl is-enabled gdm3
systemctl is-enabled dcvserver
systemctl is-active gdm3
systemctl\
        \ is-active dcvserver
pgrep -a Xorg || { journalctl -u gdm3 --no-pager -n 100; exit 1; }
dcv list-sessions
dcv\
        \ list-sessions | grep -q console
ss -lnt | grep -q ':8443 '
test "$(passwd -S workstation | awk '{print $2}')"\
        \ = L

              nvidia-smi -L | grep -E 'Tesla T4|NVIDIA T4|T4'
              test -e /dev/nvidia0
     \
        \         modinfo nvidia
              dpkg-query -W nice-dcv-gl
              test -f /etc/X11/xorg.conf
    \
        \          grep -qi nvidia /etc/X11/xorg.conf
              command -v glxinfo
              # RES validates Xorg\
        \ via its -auth file and xhost dcv access.
              auth=$(ps -eo args | grep '[X]org ' | sed -n 's/.*-auth\
        \ \([^ ]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n 1)
              test -n "$auth"
              test -r "$auth"
          \
        \    DISPLAY=:0 XAUTHORITY="$auth" xhost | grep -F 'SI:localuser:dcv'
              DISPLAY=:0 XAUTHORITY="$auth"\
        \ glxinfo -B | tee /tmp/studio-gpu-glxinfo.txt
              grep -Eiq 'OpenGL renderer string:.*(Tesla T4|NVIDIA\
        \ T4|T4)' /tmp/studio-gpu-glxinfo.txt
              ! grep -Eiq 'llvmpipe|softpipe' /tmp/studio-gpu-glxinfo.txt
"
